footer.description: Forge your media with visual FFmpeg workflows. Desktop-first, local processing, open core.

hero.title: Forge your media without the command line.
hero.lead: A desktop app that wraps FFmpeg in visual presets—export video, make GIFs, extract audio, and more. Drop a file, pick a scenario, forge.
hero.note: Open-source edition. macOS available now; Windows, Linux, and mobile coming soon.
hero.release_note: Latest macOS build · {version}. Windows, Linux, and mobile are still in development.

pillars.title: Three pillars behind every forge
pillars.lead: Visual presets, a focused forge flow, and local FFmpeg power under the hood.

items.title: Visual FFmpeg presets
items.desc: Quick Export, Make GIF, Extract Audio, image compress, and WebP convert—no terminal required.

items.title: Spark forge flow
items.desc: Drag and drop, preview inputs, watch live progress, and get polished output paths you control.

items.title: Open core, Pro-ready
items.desc: Free and open source today. AI Forge, advanced codecs, and broader media support ship in MediaForge Pro.

final_cta.title: Ready to forge your first file?
final_cta.lead: Install MediaForge on macOS and turn FFmpeg into a visual workflow in minutes.

screenshots.title: From drop to done
screenshots.lead: A focused desktop UI built around scenarios, progress, and results.

items.title: Scenario cards
items.desc: Pick the right workflow at a glance—export, GIF, audio, images.

items.title: Custom commands
items.desc: Save raw FFmpeg argv presets as home cards for expert workflows.

items.title: Input preview
items.desc: Review video inputs before you start forging.

items.title: Desktop-first
items.desc: Built for macOS and Windows with drag-and-drop and window controls.

items.title: Local processing
items.desc: Files are processed on your machine with your FFmpeg binaries.

items.title: Hardware-aware
items.desc: Preset pipelines can use VideoToolbox, NVENC, QSV, and more when available.

hero.lead: Install the open-source desktop app and start forging with visual FFmpeg presets.

platforms.title: Choose your platform
platforms.lead: We are rolling out platforms gradually—macOS first.

items.title: macOS
items.desc: Download the DMG from GitHub Releases. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH or configured in Settings.

items.title: Windows
items.desc: Desktop build for Windows is on the roadmap.

items.title: Linux
items.desc: Deb and RPM packages are planned after the macOS and Windows releases.

items.title: iOS / Android
items.desc: Mobile apps for iPhone, iPad, and Android are on the roadmap after the desktop releases.

steps.title: Install in 3 steps
steps.lead: You will need FFmpeg installed—Homebrew on macOS is the quickest path.

items.title: Install FFmpeg
items.desc: Run brew install ffmpeg (or point MediaForge to your binaries in Settings).

items.title: Download MediaForge
items.desc: Grab the latest macOS DMG from GitHub Releases and open the app.

items.title: Drop and forge
items.desc: Drag a video or image, pick a scenario, and start forging.

security.title: Local-first by design
security.lead: Processing happens on your machine with your FFmpeg install.

items.title: On-device forging
items.desc: Media files are not uploaded to MediaForge servers for conversion.

items.title: Your FFmpeg
items.desc: Use PATH discovery or set a custom ffmpeg path in Settings.

items.title: Open source
items.desc: Audit the core app code on GitHub.

items.a: Yes. MediaForge is a visual wrapper around ffmpeg and ffprobe. On macOS, brew install ffmpeg is the easiest setup.
Use the latest DMG from GitHub Releases. Apple Silicon and Intel builds are provided when available in the release assets.
The open-core edition on GitHub is free and open source. MediaForge Pro with AI Forge and advanced features is planned separately.
By default next to the source file, or in a fixed folder you choose in Settings.

items.q: When will Windows and Linux be available?
items.a: They are on the roadmap. Follow GitHub releases or star the repo for updates.
Download new DMGs from GitHub Releases. In-app update checks may be added later.

final_cta.lead: Download MediaForge for macOS and forge your first file.
